title: AliExpress US Sourcing Analysis — Import or Synthetic Demo
description: Analyze your authorized CSV/JSON product observations, or preview clearly labeled synthetic reports. No live AliExpress collection, API key, browser or proxy. One saved product analysis includes its supplied observations; start/platform usage fees also apply.

mode.title: Data mode
enumTitles: Synthetic demo — not live product data
Authorized CSV/JSON import — no live lookup
mode.description: Choose explicitly. Old live search/proxy inputs receive a migration error. Demo creates zero dataset rows and product-result events, but start/platform usage fees still apply. Imports require your own processing rights.

demoPreset.title: Synthetic US preview
enumTitles: Supplied price, cost and delivery changes
demoPreset.description: Invented developer examples only, not real AliExpress offers, history or source access. For the contribution preview, enter a hypothetical retail price and your fee/cost assumptions below.

importJson.title: Authorized product observations — JSON text
importJson.description: Paste a JSON ARRAY as text. Exactly one of importJson/importCsv, maximum 2 MiB and 1,000 observations. Required per row: productId as an 8–24 digit string, title, observedAt (UTC date/timestamp), numeric price. Do not submit private seller/customer data or credentials. No URLs/files are fetched.

importCsv.title: Authorized product observations — CSV text
importCsv.description: Paste CSV with a header, maximum 2 MiB / 1,000 observations / 60 columns. Use numeric prices without currency symbols, locale decimal commas, ranges or sold-count shorthand. Explicitly provide currency, destination, variant and offer/tax/per-unit context for valid comparisons. See README column guide.

importSource.title: Your export provider/source label
importSource.description: Required for import, maximum 160 characters. Identify your authorized feed/export. A label or confirmation does not establish a license; the Actor does not verify source accuracy, rights, freshness or current AliExpress availability. Leave empty for demo.

authorizedData.title: I have the right to process this export through this paid service
authorizedData.description: Required TRUE for import only. Confirm only for your own or properly licensed product observations. Mere public visibility, an API account or another scraper's output does not automatically allow resale/redistribution. Never auto-checked by an example.

maxResults.title: Maximum saved product analyses
maxResults.description: Import only: one billed dataset row per unique productId, including all its supplied variants and times. First-seen products are selected; omitted products are not exported or billed. This is not a row or per-query cap. Demo creates no product results.

retailPriceUsd.title: Hypothetical resale price — USD per unit
retailPriceUsd.description: Optional scenario assumption, NOT a forecast. Same entered retail price applies to all selected quotes. Calculated only for explicit US / USD / per-unit / standard offers with known shipping, additional tax and duty. No currency conversion or legal tax/tariff estimates.

marketplaceFeePercent.title: Assumed marketplace fee — % of resale price
marketplaceFeePercent.description: Your assumption, not current Amazon/Shopify/TikTok rates. Default 0 is an assumption, not proof that fees are absent. Combined marketplace/payment/returns reserve must be below 100%.

paymentFeePercent.title: Assumed payment fee — % of resale price
paymentFeePercent.description: Your scenario assumption. Default 0; enter the applicable value for your workflow. Not a current rate lookup.

returnsReservePercent.title: Assumed returns reserve — % of resale price
returnsReservePercent.description: Your modeled reserve, not a predicted return rate. Default 0. Overhead and income taxes are not modeled.

fixedFeeUsd.title: Assumed fixed fee — USD per unit
fixedFeeUsd.description: User-entered scenario fee. Default 0, not a verified absence of costs.

fulfillmentCostUsd.title: Assumed fulfillment — USD per unit
fulfillmentCostUsd.description: Per-unit scenario cost beyond the imported quote. Do not double-count costs already included in imported shipping. Default 0.

adCostUsd.title: Assumed advertising — USD per sold unit
adCostUsd.description: Your acquisition-cost assumption, not a conversion or sales prediction. Default 0.

targetContributionMarginPercent.title: Scenario contribution target — % of resale price
targetContributionMarginPercent.description: Used for the hypothetical ad-budget threshold. Contribution is not net profit or a guarantee the product will sell. Negative margins and negative affordable ad budgets remain visible.

priceChangeThresholdPercent.title: Supplied price change review threshold — %
priceChangeThresholdPercent.description: Findings for rises or falls between matching supplied standard quotes. Raw unrounded change decides the threshold. Zero baselines and changed context do not produce percent alerts. No live monitoring or notification.

landedCostRiseThresholdPercent.title: Entered landed-cost rise review threshold — %
landedCostRiseThresholdPercent.description: Only when both supplied quotes have all required cost components and matching context. Never fills missing shipping, tax or duty with zero.

deliveryIncreaseThresholdDays.title: Supplied maximum delivery increase threshold — days
deliveryIncreaseThresholdDays.description: Review increased deliveryDaysMax between comparable supplied quotes. The estimate is user-provided and is not a delivery promise.

comparisonWindowDays.title: Maximum comparison time gap — days
comparisonWindowDays.description: Larger supplied time gaps remain explicit but do not trigger numerical price/cost/delivery/stock findings. No hidden persistent history or schedule is created.
